reason: A DSH Web UI plugin that adds a conversation-turn timeline, hover summaries, and navigation to historical turns, with automatic loading of older conversation history.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加对话轮次时间线、悬浮历史概览卡片以及快速跳转到历史消息的导航体验。
summaries.en: Adds a conversation-turn timeline, hover history summaries, and quick navigation to historical messages in the DSH Web UI.

capabilities: Reads conversation turns from the DSH Web UI
Renders a timeline rail and hover overview cards
Filters displayed conversation content for summaries
Navigates to conversation turns and loads older history on interaction
